scope: midi-note-storage-v4 partial clauses only; six carried group and two added local reader comparisons, separate from public Open/Save
fixture_origin: Independently authored gzip Live Sets; no shipped file copied or excerpted
oracle_status: Static-derived and extracted-execution expectations (label per case); neither the reference application nor a candidate executed

representation.action: open, or open-save (open, then save as a new set without other changes)
representation.saved_notes: key_tracks (midi_key, notes as attribute name to exact text), event_lists (NoteId, CC, events as attribute name to exact text), note_id_next
representation.note: project comparison representation, not an API of the original application or a required design
representation.local_action: validate-notes: project comparison of the supplied decoded Notes domain; no public validation API, native call or implementation pipeline is specified
representation.local_reader_outcome: refused or admitted by the exact bounded local clause named in the case; no public opening, catch/state/rollback, saved text, whole-load counter repair or later effect assertion
representation.input_projection: Optional exact attribute edits over decoded Notes of the named authored fixture; element paths are relative to Notes, indices are one-based, and every matched element receives the stated attribute text. Input data only, not a required implementation procedure.
